{{Top|leg}}
A '''fuel converter''' was a device that allowed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] to forego the expense of buying new [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]] or refueling. [[Fuel/Legends|Fuel]] converters converted other materials, including waste material<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> and [[Methane/Legends|methane]],<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|A Free-Trader's Guide to the Planets}}</ref> into fuel. Three types were in general use; [[Solid Fuel Converter]]s, [[Scoop]]s, and [[Solar Converter]]s.<ref name="GG6" />

Fuel converters were parts used in [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]] and were used in trades. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Qui-Gon Jinn acquired a fuel converter to trade for parts for [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's podracer]].<ref name="EpI game">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Fuel converters appear in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]. The player, in the guise of Jinn, must trade for parts to repair Skywalker's podracer during the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] mission.
